Discoverer: Weipeng Jiang (@Krace) from Codesafe Team of Legendsec at Qi'anxin Group
Method of Attack: Heap buffer overflow in FreeType's Load_SBit_Png function processing PNG images embedded into fonts
Use after free vulnerabilities in Blink, media, PDFium, and printing components
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in FreeType via crafted PNG images in fonts
Use after free bugs exploited in browser components
Indicators of Compromise: Exploit exists in the wild for CVE-2020-15999
